meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装并接线 HyperFrames 的界面构建块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用 HyperFrames 搭建应用
copy.tagline_en: Install and wire HyperFrames building blocks into your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 帮用户安装、查找和接线 HyperFrames 注册表里的块与组件:执行 hyperframes add/catalog,把块挂进 index.html,把组件片段并入合成,并处理 hyperframes.json;也能按模板新建块/组件并提交 PR。
howto.when: 当你要运行 hyperframes add/catalog 安装或搜索、把注册表块/组件接入 index.html、处理 hyperframes.json 等注册表相关操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我运行 hyperframes add data-chart 安装图表块
搜索一下能逐行揭示标题的块
say.note: 会执行 catalog --query,按英文意图检索目录。

say.text: 把 grain-overlay 组件接进我的合成
say.note: 会读取组件文件,指导粘贴 HTML/CSS/JS。

howto.what_en: Installs, finds, and wires HyperFrames registry blocks/components: runs hyperframes add/catalog, mounts blocks into index.html, merges component snippets, handles hyperframes.json, and scaffolds new items for upstream PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user runs hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, asks to install or search registry blocks/components, wire them into index.html, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes add data-chart to install the chart block.
say_en.note: Downloads the block and prints wiring attributes to add.

say_en.text: Search for a block that reveals a headline line by line.
Wire the grain-overlay component into my composition.
say_en.note: Reads the component file and explains where to paste HTML/CSS/JS.
